artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling with his body turned slightly to the side. He has a prominent forehead, a beard, and a contemplative expression. His hair is wavy and receding, with a halo around his head. He wears a detailed robe. There is a lion at his feet, a small table with a skull and crossbones, and a crucifix nearby. In the foreground, there is a vase or pedestal, and a book or box on stones. The background has architectural and natural elements, including columns, ruins, vegetation, and buildings extending into the distance.

artworks.title: Road Map of Central Europe
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.dimensions:
image: 40.7 x 29.1 cm (16 x 11 7/16 in.)
sheet: 41.6 x 30.2 cm (16 3/8 x 11 7/8 in.)
overall (exterior frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an old map depicting various geographical regions and landmarks. The image consists of a detailed, monochromatic map featuring numerous place names and topographical features, such as rivers, mountains, and seas, all densely labeled in a historical script. The map highlights an intricate network of towns, regions, and natural features. Architectural elements like castles or walled towns are illustrated with small sketches, and the border of the map contains additional information. The style and design suggest the map serves as both a navigational tool and a work of art, reflecting historic cartographic techniques.

artworks.title: The Dissolute Household
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several figures engaged in various activities. The setting features a room populated with furniture and tools associated with cobbling or leatherwork, suggesting a workshop environment. There are children present causing a commotion, one riding a barrel-like object, another with a basket on their head, and a third interacting with an adult figure at the center who is crafting or carving a shoe. An distracted adult figure leans against a bench on the left. Tools and shoes hang from the walls. Detailed hatching and lines give depth and texture to the scene. The upper region features a smaller inset with an adult figure sitting by a window with a contemplative expression. The style suggests detailed early modern engravings, capturing both chaos and craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Ornament - Large Goblet
artworks.medium: punch engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated chalice or goblet. The design features intricate line work with elaborate floral and scroll motifs throughout. The upper section has a detailed depiction of a face with curly hair. The stem is adorned with bird figures, possibly eagles or griffins. The base is also adorned with complex patterns and another face within an oval frame. The style suggests a Renaissance influence, emphasizing symmetry, mythological elements, and decorative motifs.

artworks.title: Saint Michael
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel defeating a dragon. The image shows a winged figure dressed in flowing robes, holding a cross-topped staff, and pinning down a dragon-like creature beneath them. The wings of the figure are prominently displayed, and the expression on the face is serene and determined. The dragon has a distinct head with pronounced features and is positioned beneath the angel. The lines of the drawing are finely detailed, capturing the textures of the robes and wings with precision.

artworks.title: At the Dram Well
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon featuring a distant cityscape, a rocky hill with two small figures on top, two figures near a well or apparatus in the foreground, and various trees scattered across the undulating terrain. The painting displays loose and expressive brushstrokes with lines defining forms and volume. The monochromatic sepia palette creates a warm atmosphere, while the sky is filled with billowing clouds.

artworks.title: Young Man Drinking Water (Rebecca and Eliezer?)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people, primarily women, in various standing, bending, and kneeling positions, handling large urns or vessels. The figures have detailed facial features and curly or wavy hair, wearing classical draped garments. They are set against lush vegetation with trees and bushes, alongside intricate woodwork structures. The scene suggests an outdoor setting near a water source.

artworks.title: Caricature of J.M. Whistler
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an individual seated sideways on a chair, with crossed legs and gesturing with one hand. The person has curly hair, a prominent nose, and large lips. They are wearing a hat, a suit with a flower pinned to the chest, and pointed shoes. The background has a simple design with curtain-like lines, and a butterfly near the person's hand. The scene is framed within a border.

artworks.title: Withered Spring
artworks.medium: pen and black ink heightened with white over graphite

artworks.title: Tannhäuser
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash heightened with white
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person reaching out with both arms extended forward. The person has a determined expression and long hair styled back. They are wearing a robe with visible folds, surrounded by intricate botanical elements like flowers and leaves. In the background, there are vertical lines resembling tree trunks. The artwork is monochromatic with detailed line work. At the bottom, the word "TANNHÄUSER" is surrounded by floral motifs and vines.

artworks.title: Cow Drinking
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image features a frontal view of a rustic landscape. On the left, there are animals, including cows and goats, and an old stone structure covered with plants. The structure has engraved figures on top. In the background, there are figures, including a man with a staff and two seated figures interacting. The scene extends to show hills, trees, and clouds in the sky. The style includes detailed brushstrokes and etching, with fine lines for texture and shading. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on light and shadow for contrast and texture.

artworks.title: Madame Besnard
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting at a table, facing right, with their head slightly bowed. The individual has medium-length, dark, wavy hair covering their ears. They have soft facial features, including a delicate nose and lips. The person wears a long-sleeved garment with a textured, patterned fabric and slightly puffed sleeves. Their arm rests on the table. The background features wavy horizontal lines, possibly representing a draped curtain or wall covering.

artworks.title: La Femme (frontispiece)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's body from the knees up, with the majority of her figure enveloped in shadow. She is positioned slightly off-center, with her left arm raised and bent at the elbow, her hand resting near her neck. Her face is softly lit, featuring delicate, refined features and dark, short hair that frames her face. The clothing, or fabric, drapes over her lower body and appears intricate, blending into the heavily shadowed and textured background. The woman appears to be emerging from the shadows, with no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is a dark, abstract texture that contrasts with the light on her face and chest.

artworks.title: The Sick Mother (La mère malade)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This etching depicts a woman reclining in bed, looking towards two children positioned near her. The woman is on the right side of the image, facing to the left towards the children, who are in profile. She has light skin, delicate facial features, and dark hair covered with a white cloth. She is wearing white clothing that blends into the bedding she sits on. On the left, the two children stand at the foot of her bed. One of the children, closer to the woman, has long hair and is dressed in darker clothing. They hold a bowl out towards the woman. The other child has short hair and is also dressed in dark clothing, and they lean on a nearby surface, looking towards the woman. In the background, dark curtains frame the bed.

artworks.title: Woman Reading in the Studio (La Lecture dans l'atelier)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person reclined with their back supported by a cushion or armrest. The person's profile is visible, showcasing facial features such as a defined nose and closed or relaxed eyes. Their hair appears to be short or medium-length, styled to cover the ears and the back of the neck. The person is wearing a loose robe or gown. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background includes a textured wall with wooden elements and stacked books or similar objects on shelves.

artworks.title: Bathing at Talloires (La baignade à Talloires)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures near a large wooden boat. The scene depicts two figures, one standing knee-deep in water, engaged in an activity at the water's surface while another figure sits on the edge of a shoreline or a dock, observing. The large wooden boat dominates the background, displaying intricate line work capturing the planks and texture. The water shows ripples and reflections, elegantly rendered through delicate lines and shading. The drawing uses a monochromatic palette, likely created with pen or etching, emphasizing the play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Woman in a Cape (La femme à la pèlerine)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a woman depicted from approximately thigh-up. She is positioned in a standing pose, slightly turned to her left, with her right hand resting on the back of a chair or a structure. Her head is turned over her shoulder to face the viewer, with softly rendered facial features and wavy, medium-length hair framing her face. The woman is dressed in flowing, layered attire, possibly a gown or wrap, and there are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is simple and unadorned, with faint lines suggesting a potential setting.

artworks.title: Intimacy (Intimité)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated in a room. Both are sitting on chairs, facing towards a light source, likely a window. The focus is on their upper bodies. The individuals' facial features are obscured in the dimly lit room. One person has their head resting on their hand. They have dark hair and are wearing dark clothing, blending with the surroundings. There are no visible accessories or objects. The room features heavy curtains and furniture, creating a cozy atmosphere. A dim light source like a lamp or fireplace illuminates the room.

artworks.title: Eve
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude female figure shown from the thighs up. The woman's body is depicted in a slightly reclined position, with her right arm raised and bent at the elbow, resting across her face just above her forehead. Her head is turned slightly to the left, and her facial features are softened and serene, with her eyes closed or looking downward. Her hair is medium length and wavy, cascading and blending into the sketch's shading. The background is rendered with dynamic linear strokes, forming a textured and abstract surrounding that adds depth and contrast to the figure. The composition's technique highlights the contours and form of the woman's body without any specific focus on clothing or external objects. The drawing is signed at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Pony (Le poney)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse standing in front of a wooden wall. The horse is shown in profile with a well-defined muscular structure. The texture of the horse's coat is rendered with cross-hatching. The wooden wall behind the horse has vertical lines suggesting wood grain, and the horse's shadow is cast onto the wall. A light source appears to come from the left, creating contrast in shading. The drawing has an earthy tone, capturing the presence of the horse.

artworks.title: The Flirt (Le flirt)
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting next to each other. The figure on the left is leaning closely towards the other. The person on the right is seated with relaxed posture on an ornate chair, their head resting against their hand as they gaze downward. Their facial features are soft and their hair is styled back, appearing dark in color. They are wearing a light-colored dress with long sleeves that covers their entire body down to the feet. The dress flows over the side of the chair. The person on the left is depicted in shadow and also leans on the chair, with minimal visible clothing details. The setting appears to be indoors with a large window on the right, bright compared to the shadowy room, and offers a stark contrast to the darker space surrounding the figures. The window has some faint lines indicating objects in the background.

artworks.title: A Martyr (Un martyre)
artworks.medium: etching on Canson & Mongolfier laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures wrapped in a large cloak or drapery. One figure's head and shoulders are visible, while the other's face is shown. The first figure's head is partially covered by the drapery. The second figure appears to be resting against the first. The background features tall, slender tree trunks without leaves, suggesting a barren landscape. The artwork includes etched lines that add texture and depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Silk Gown (La robe de soie)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting in a chair. They are leaning slightly to one side with their hand on their face. They have a calm expression, delicate features, and short dark hair. The individual is wearing an elaborate, voluminous gown. The chair appears to be made of dark wood. The background shows a patterned floor and shadows, hinting at an indoor setting with light coming through windows.

artworks.title: In the Embers (Dans les cendres)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and roulette on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person with crossed arms, tilted head, looking forward. The person has prominent facial features, short wavy hair, and is wearing a long-sleeved garment. The background is dark and textured, creating a dimly-lit environment around the person.
